mapper.select: SELECT template_id AS templateId, create_request_sha256 AS requestSha256 FROM lbl_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT template_id AS templateId, template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, version_no AS versionNo, scope_type AS scopeType, store_id AS storeId, body_template AS bodyTemplate, state, content_sha256 AS contentSha256, published_at AS publishedAt, version FROM lbl_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND (scope_type = 'TENANT' OR (scope_type = 'STORE' AND store_id = #{storeId})) ORDER BY (scope_type = 'STORE') DESC, version_no DESC, template_id DESC LIMIT 1
